# Krita

> Krita is a free and open-source digital painting application with professional tools for artists, animators, and digital creators.

Krita is a KDE project offering cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android) with features including animation tools, advanced brush engines, and community-driven development. The project is funded through donations and maintained by a global community of contributors.

## Key Topics

- Digital Painting
- Animation Tools
- Open Source
- Cross-Platform (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android)
- Brush Engines
- Free Software
- KDE Project
- Bug Fixes & Stability
- Feature Requests
- Community Contributions
- Release Cycles
- Python Support
- Wacom Support
- Platform Updates

- [Krita 5.2.11 Released!](https://krita.org/en/posts/2025/krita-5-2-11-released): Bugfix release for Krita 5.2.11 with Android canvas fixes.
- [Krita 5.1.4 Released](https://krita.org/en/posts/2022/krita-5-1-4-released): Bugfix release announcement for Krita 5.1.4 with dependency updates.
- [Krita 4.4.5 Released](https://krita.org/en/posts/2021/krita-4-4-5-released): Final bugfix release for Krita 4.4.5 before Krita 5.0 launch.
- [Krita 4.2.9 Released](https://krita.org/en/posts/2020/krita-4-2-9-released): Release announcement for Krita 4.2.9 with bug fixes and platform updates.
- [Second Beta for Krita 4.3.0 Released](https://krita.org/en/posts/2020/second-beta-for-krita-4-3-0-released): Beta release announcement for Krita 4.3.0 with animation and Wacom support.
- [Krita 3.1 Release Candidate](https://krita.org/en/posts/2016/krita-3-1-release-candidate): Release candidate announcement for Krita 3.1 with bug fixes.
- [Krita 3.1 Beta 4 Released](https://krita.org/en/posts/2016/krita-3-1-beta-4-released): Beta release for Krita 3.1 with official macOS support.

## Major Releases & Milestones

- [Krita 3.0: The Animation Release](https://krita.org/en/posts/2016/krita-3-0-release-notes): Major release announcement for Krita 3.0 with animation tools and Qt 5 migration.
- [Krita Available from the Windows Store](https://krita.org/en/posts/2017/krita-available-from-the-windows-store): Distribution announcement for Krita availability on Windows Store.
- [Krita in 2022 and 2023](https://krita.org/en/posts/2023/krita-in-2022-and-2023): Yearly overview and retrospective of Krita development in 2022-2023.
- [Krita in 2019 and 2020](https://krita.org/en/posts/2020/krita-in-2019-and-2020): Yearly review of Krita development progress and statistics for 2019-2020.
